scope: Independent review of the local dialogue continuity correction within the connected Groups 1-8 implementation. This is not production, live-provider, learner or performance qualification.

findings.finding: First Mara contact and premature choices
findings.result: First story action is watching Mara help passengers. Untimed conversation parts establish work hours and passenger obligations before replies.

findings.finding: Unclear speakers and unsupported bridge promise
findings.result: Named speakers remain separate from original source tokens. The bridge repair does not claim to change Mara’s work hours.

findings.finding: Page possession, reporting, telling and rereading conflated
findings.result: Giving Mara’s page, reporting her circumstances and performing her story are distinct. Reopening an earlier account is read only, including beside its author.

findings.finding: Bird repair and later story events shown too early
findings.result: The player hears the boy’s situation, receives consent, fetches tape and guides Mara through repair. Pip remains in the present garden.
Fresh final-build native contact contains one bread promise and no repeated footer notice; the spare tile is introduced before the offer.

findings.finding: Largest-text small-screen passage crowded out by controls
findings.result: At 320x568 the Chromium source viewport is199.96875px, up from about70px; actual story text stays28px with roomier lines. Full sentence, word-help return and both replies were checked visually.

findings.finding: Leaving unfinished Mara dialogue could hide bridge travel
findings.result: Fresh final-build play can leave Mara, build the bridge and visit the bakery without completing her conversation.
